meta.title: FinTax workbench
meta.description: DSH sidebar workbench for offline statements, .zip archives, and domestic corporate bank receipts across 11 sales platforms and 6 settlement wallets with Stage 3 5-key reconciliation, 14 deterministic tax calculators (EU EUR 3+2 parcels, US Type 11 vs 9810 DDP with IEEPA/FIOR gates, FBA mixed procurement split), annual Q1–Q4 & 2027-01-31 3-jurisdiction compliance checks, entity reassignment/backup, and an inline Tencent IMA citation drawer.
